messages:
Ellie: quick PSA + mood-lift 1: Comet (the office parrot) learned how to tap the Slack notification sound on my laptop and now thinks it's his personal ringtone. video attached: comet_ring.mp4 https://imgur.com/comet_ring :parrot:
Raj: i can't believe i'm jealous of a bird's calendar invites :joy: does he accept meeting invites?
Ellie: only if the subject line contains the word 'treat' or my lunch status. he squawks once for 'in a meeting', twice for 'available'.
Noah: demo pls. i need this as my OOO auto-reply replacement.
Ellie: uploading clip `comet_sq1.mp4` showing double-squawk for 'available' 1 https://imgur.com/comet_vid1.mp4
Carmen: do we have any policy on parrots joining video calls? asking for HR :thinking:
Ellie: HR said "only if the parrot's camera angles are professional." also he enjoys camera close-ups.
Raj: noted. adding "parrot cameo" to #team-rituals agenda. also, does he mimic anyone?
Ellie: he has a perfect impression of our buildbot when it's unhappy. yesterday he replicated the exact three-tone error chime and terrified two interns. :sweat_smile:
Noah: that's both alarming and wildly useful for debugging dramatic failures.
Carmen: poll: should we add Comet as a guest on next week's standup to deliver "wins" in squawks? react :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no
Raj: +1 from me. i'll prepare a translator sheet.
Ellie: also fun fact: he tries to type with his beak on the wireless keyboard. result is mostly `dfkj##` and inspirational chaos.
sticker-bot: :parrot: sticker added
Noah: suggestion: company merch idea 1 "Comet's Favorite Crumbs" cookie tins. proceeds go to birdseed.
Carmen: naming contest? 'Comet', 'Beaky McBeakface', 'Squawk Sinatra' all on the table.
Ellie: update at 14:12: Comet successfully triggered the coffee machine beep by pecking the control panel. productivity +10, suspicion of caffeine theft +100.
Raj: i'm drafting a formal request to grant him a spare keycard.
Noah: conclusion: 1) we are now a hybrid office + aviary, 2) mandatory parrot cameo at next all-hands, 3) someone please back up the buildbot chime file.
Ellie: will share a highlights reel later. end of thread.
